sentences.en: The sled accelerated as it went down the icy slope.
sentences.zh: 雪橇在冰坡上加速下滑。

sentences.en: You must admit this would present quite a slippery slope.
sentences.zh: 你必须承认这会成为一个很危险的先例。

sentences.en: See you on the slopes at the crack of dawn!
sentences.zh: 黎明即起，在滑雪场上见！

senses.zh: 倾斜；斜率；斜坡；扛枪姿势 -
